summary: Client only. Shapes and paints the level's ground in this game only, as an editor does under a building it places: a flat pad, a hill, a hollow, a cobbled lane. The ground is solid at once where it now lies. The server does not know about it, and no other player sees it. Every edit can be undone, and a resource's edits are undone when it stops or the world goes. An edit reaches at most 90 m from its middle; ground pushed beyond what its patch of terrain can hold stops at that height.

flatten.summary: Brings the ground in the circle to one height, fading into the ground around it. Throws a TypeError for a bad place, size or height, a RangeError for one out of the world or wider than 90 m.

params.center: Its middle; z is not used.
params.radius: Metres of flat ground from the middle.
params.height: The height of the flat ground, in metres.
params.falloff: Optional: metres over which it fades into the ground around. The radius by default.

flatten.exampleLua:
-- client
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local pad = kcds.world.Terrain.flatten(Vector3.new(120, 200, 0), 7, 14.5, 6)
kcds.world.Prefab.place("house_1s_4r_angled_a_dobesovicko", Vector3.new(120, 200, 14.5))

raise.summary: Lifts the ground in the circle by an amount, or lowers it with a negative one, fading at the edge.

params.center: Its middle; z is not used.
params.radius: Metres from the middle at full strength.
params.amount: Metres up, or down when negative.
params.falloff: Optional: metres over which it fades. The radius by default.

raise.exampleLua:
-- client
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local hill = kcds.world.Terrain.raise(Vector3.new(120, 200, 0), 3, 4, 6)
hill:undo()

paint.summary: Covers the ground in the circle with a material: its look, the sound of footsteps on it and the dust it raises. Full in the circle, blended into the ground around over the falloff (up to three materials mix on one metre). A World Architect custom map carries all of the materials everywhere. On a game level a name finds the level's own material of that kind (its cobblestones, sand or trampled soil), and a patch of terrain without it takes it in; a material the level does not have at all (such as gravel on one level) leaves the ground as it was. Roads lie over the ground and hide paint under them. Throws a TypeError for a bad place, size or material number, a RangeError for an unknown material name or a place out of the world or wider than 90 m.

params.center: Its middle; z is not used.
params.radius: Metres from the middle fully covered.
params.material: A name: 'grass', 'meadow', 'pasture', 'trampled', 'soil', 'mud', 'stony_mud', 'sand', 'gravel', 'forest', 'forest_leaves', 'cobblestones', 'paving', 'cobblestones_grass' or 'river_shore'; or the level's surface type number (0 to 126).
params.falloff: Optional: metres over which it blends into the ground around. The radius by default.

paint.exampleLua:
-- client: a cobbled lane through a meadow
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3
local Terrain = kcds.world.Terrain

for x = 100, 140, 2 do
  Terrain.paint(Vector3.new(x, 200, 0), 1.5, "cobblestones", 1)
end

hideGrass.summary: Takes the level's grass carpet away in the circle, in this game only: a yard, a threshing floor or the floor of a house stands bare. Trees, bushes and the ground itself stay. The grass comes back when the edit is undone or the resource stops. Throws a TypeError for a bad place or size, a RangeError for a radius of 0, more than 90 m or a place out of the world.

params.center: Its middle; z is not used.
params.radius: Metres from the middle without grass.

hideGrass.exampleLua:
-- client: a bare yard around a new house
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3
local Terrain = kcds.world.Terrain

local yard = Terrain.hideGrass(Vector3.new(2675, 1562, 0), 12)
-- later, the grass back: yard:undo()

blockNavmesh.summary: Closes the game's navmesh in a box, in this game only: the NPCs this game moves plan their paths around it, as around a wall (a house placed on a game map, a fenced yard). The level's own navigation is opened again when the edit is undone or the resource stops. A box is laid on the navmesh tiles there now and again every few seconds, as tiles load. Throws a TypeError for a bad place, a RangeError for a box wider than 180 m or out of the world.

params.min: The box's lowest corner. Without z the box reaches far under the ground.
params.max: The box's highest corner. Without z the box reaches far over the ground.

blockNavmesh.exampleLua:
-- client: nobody walks through the new barn
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3
local Terrain = kcds.world.Terrain

local barn = Terrain.blockNavmesh(Vector3.new(2670, 1555, 30), Vector3.new(2682, 1563, 40))
-- later, open again: barn:undo()

findPath.summary: The way on the game's navmesh from one place to another, as this game's NPCs would walk it: { reaches, points }, the points from the start to the end. When the goal cannot be walked to, reaches is false and the points end where the search came nearest to it. Returns null when the navmesh there is not loaded in this game or the start or the goal is more than 3 m off it (Terrain.nearestWalkable puts a place on it). Paths around Terrain.blockNavmesh boxes go around them. Throws a TypeError for a place without x, y and z.

params.from: Where the way starts (x, y, z).
params.to: Where it should end (x, y, z).

findPath.exampleLua:
-- client: is the well reachable on foot from here?
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3
local Terrain = kcds.world.Terrain
local me = kcds.players.LocalPlayer.position

local path = Terrain.findPath(me, Vector3.new(2680, 1560, 32))
if path and path.reaches then
  print("The well is " .. #path.points .. " turns away")
end

nearestWalkable.summary: The point of the game's navmesh nearest to a place, where an NPC of this game can stand: within reach metres of it across and twice that up and down. Returns null when there is none (or the navmesh there is not loaded in this game). Throws a TypeError for a place without x, y and z, a RangeError for a reach not above 0 or over 50.

params.reach: How far to look, in metres: 3 by default, at most 50.

nearestWalkable.exampleLua:
-- client: a spot to stand on near the market cross
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3
local Terrain = kcds.world.Terrain

local spot = Terrain.nearestWalkable(Vector3.new(2675, 1562, 30), 10)
if spot then
  print(string.format("Stand at %.1f %.1f %.1f", spot.x, spot.y, spot.z))
end

materials.summary: The material names paint takes, each with the level's surface type number it stands for.
materials.exampleLua:
-- client
local names = {}
for name in pairs(kcds.world.Terrain.materials()) do
  table.insert(names, name)
end
print("Ground materials: " .. table.concat(names, ", "))

edits.summary: Your resource's edits that are still in place, oldest first.
edits.exampleLua:
-- client
for _, edit in ipairs(kcds.world.Terrain.edits():reverse()) do
  edit:undo()
end
